eos_recommendation: OBSERVE / DEFER. The transferable mechanism is the compact page snapshot (~200-400 tokens per page instead of raw HTML), which is directly relevant to the Token & Context Hygiene Protocol section 8; the tool itself is not adoptable now. Reasons: (1) L0 purity forbids an external binary as a root dependency; (2) it is a CLI skill, not MCP, so it does not fit the existing adapter seam without a new adapter; (3) acting with the PO's real authenticated sessions raises the blast radius to CRITICAL and requires per-action PO authorization under AGENTS section 5, not blanket autonomy; (4) the benchmark is vendor-authored. Do NOT add to docs/tools/REGISTRY.json: that registry requires a provider_id, capability identifiers and evidence, and the interface_type enum has no entry for a browser CLI skill.
